Made first for the Tokyo market, and now a Japantown favorite. It's a shifting face and a fox's tail for people who like to be someone else by morning. Extra tails are a popular upsell.

Package: FantaForm
Humanity Loss: 22
Includes: Exotic Bodysculpting (fox ears), AudioVox, Combat Tail, Cyberaudio Suite w/ Amplified Hearing, Cybereye ×2 w/ Color Shift ×2 and LL/IR/UV ×2, Kaleidoscopic Electric Reflection System (KERS)

Install the pieces it includes as cyberware; the package price covers them all.

Item Compendium (2070) • Cyberware
